faq.a: A DJ based in Dubai playing house, afro house and melodic sets at Moe's on the 5th and Soho Garden.
Moe's on the 5th (Sheraton Grand, Sheikh Zayed Road) and Soho Garden (Meydan), Dubai. Dates are announced on Instagram @arshia.wav and to the list.

faq.q: How do I get on arshia.wav's guest list?
faq.a: Join the list on arshia.wav's site with your name, Instagram and WhatsApp. Nights are sent out before each date.
Email the bookings address on the site or message @arshia.wav on Instagram.
